messages:
Incident-Bot: ALERT: p99 streaming decode latency > 2.5s for the past 10m on prod-us-west (auto-escalation). Affected route: /v1/generate-stream.
Alex: seeing the same on dashboards. p95 up ~300ms, p99 jump to 2.8s. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/streaming-latency?var-region=us-west
Maria: confirmed. Topology shows most traffic hitting runtime-pool-gpu-7/8. Notable: recent kernel-variant rollout (trt8-compile-v23) finished ~30m ago.
Chris: could be the new compilepath/flashattn flags; we rolled vf-prefetch and flashquant in that rollout.
Jen: can we triage quickly — any customer-facing errors?
Samir: minimal 5xxs, mostly timeouts on long-prompt streaming sessions. I see increased tail on nodes with nvlink-bound memory patterns.
Priya: creating an incident page. severity: Sev2 (customer-visible degradation, no full outage).
Incident-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-7412345678. Pager notified.
Alex: immediate mitigation proposal: route new streaming requests to dedicated legacy pool (runtime-legacy-gpu-*), reduce canary weight to 0 for trt8-compile-v23.
Maria: agree. Also start a quick rollback of compiler flag ff_flashquant=on -> off on a small subset to test.
Chris: pushing a traffic rule to steer 80% of streaming traffic to legacy pool in us-west. Command: `./opsctl route set --region us-west --route /v1/generate-stream --target runtime-legacy --weight 80`
Jen: I'm on the rollback of flags. Applying patch to runtime config on pool runtime-pool-gpu-7:```yaml
- name: ff_flashquant
  value: off
- name: trt_kernel_variant
  value: trt8-compile-v22
```
Samir: rolling config out to pool-7 only for now. watching logs. tail metrics streaming p99 back down to 1.3s within 4m of change.
Priya: excellent. record customer impact: 7 enterprise customers on long-prompt endpoints experienced noticeable latency — SLAs at risk. Noticing one large customer (AcmeMedia) had multiple degraded sessions. Notifying CSM.
Incident-Bot: Postmortem checklist populated at https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-7412345678/checklist
Alex: root-cause hypothesis: compilepath+flashquant kernel variant increased memory paging on certain NV cache lines with long KV-cache retention, causing sporadic decode stalls at tail. Likely exacerbated by batch shape distribution on live traffic.
Chris: we should capture perf traces. Run this on affected node: `sudo perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf.tr; sudo perf script > /tmp/perf.unfolded` and upload to the incident bucket.
Jen: logs and perf uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/7412345678/perf.tar.gz
Samir: mitigation status: traffic steer done, flag rollback partial, canary weight set to 0, nodes with variant trt8-compile-v23 are cordoned for rebuild. p99 now 0.9-1.2s and stable for 12m.
Priya: moving to handoff notes for next oncall (UTC+2 shift): - Incident ID INC-2026-7412345678 - Current status: mitigated, traffic steered to legacy pool, rollback in progress, awaiting kernel rebuild and full rollback verification. - Important artifacts: perf traces, grafana link, config diff (https://git.redwood/ops/runtime-rollbacks/changes/7412345678). - Customer impact: AcmeMedia notified, CSM engaged.
Alex: next steps: 1) Full rollback of trt8-compile-v23 from prod if we confirm perf traces. 2) Run targeted regression suite for streaming tail with long KV retention shapes. 3) Prepare a controlled re-roll with additional telemetry (kv-cache hit/output timing).
Maria: assigning owners: rollback (Jen), perf analysis (Chris), routing & SLO monitoring (Alex), customer comms (Priya).
Jen: will continue rollout to remaining affected pools after handoff, will coordinate with infra for kernel rebuild.
Chris: will post a short forensic summary with flame graphs and the top syscall waits within 2h.
Priya: handoff ETA: 20:00 UTC. Please add to the incident doc any additional checks run.
Samir: adding quick runbook excerpt for next oncall: - verify p99 < 1.2s for 15m - ensure canary weight remains 0 - confirm no new 5xx spikes - if p99 climbs, throttle streaming concurrency and escalate to eng-runtime.
Alex: thanks team. I'll update the incident timeline and tag eng-runtime and eng-sre for follow-up. :thumbsup:
Incident-Bot: Incident INC-2026-7412345678 status updated -> mitigated (partial). Handoff ready.
